blocking_questions: Post-PRD recommendation "Behavior change provenance inventory" references external task prerequisite(s) T18; record completion or approved deferral evidence before dispatch

collaboration_rationale: Generated post-PRD decomposition runs serially until boundaries, validation, and merge policy are reviewed.

factoryd_runtime.approval_posture: human approval required for live credentials, high-risk tasks, and merge
factoryd_runtime.credential_posture: no ambient secrets during deterministic bootstrap

feedback_plan: Use repo-configured validation commands, validation reports, PR lifecycle reports, and scope closure.
level_gates: Human approval before live credentials or network
objective: Implement post-PRD recommendations from .factory/artifacts/post-prd/behavior-version-control/source.md through governed vertical slices.

plan_drift_policy.rule: Update context brief, execution plan, task packets, validation contract, acceptance ledger, acceptance mapping, scope closure, and generated factoryd config before continuing after post-PRD alignment drift.

recovery_policy: Generate repair task and stop on validation, path policy, or closure failure.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Deleting any task output should be detectable by validation or scope closure.

runtime_pins.dependency_policy: inherit repo operating pack; pin and justify dependencies
runtime_pins.live_work_policy: no ambient secrets or live network by default

scope_exclusions: Do not mutate docs/product/prd.md unless the recommendation explicitly changes product scope.
Do not add live credentials or network access without approval.
Do not mark judgment-only acceptance complete without human approval evidence.
slice_rationale: Each generated task maps one post-PRD recommendation to implementation, tests, evidence, and closure.
state_impact: Repo-local source and Factory artifacts only.
system_model_summary: State is repo-local; feedback is command and artifact based.
